correctness.rationale: The even solution of Df''=sf with endpoint value 1 is the cosh quotient; multiplying Euler factors gives v+(1-v)λ_j/(λ_j+s), v=u². The sum of independent Bernoulli-thinned exponentials is integrable and has a finite mgf for z<λ_0 near zero: the logarithms converge locally normally by ∑1/λ_j<∞. Expanding log(1-vz/λ_j)-log(1-z/λ_j) gives (m-1)!(1-v^m)∑λ_j^{-m}. Uniform Poisson redirection has exit probability 1-a/π per tumble, so its matched rate is 1/μ, verifying all scale factors. The log derivative of (1-v^m)/(1-v)^m is positive and C_m<1 by ∑q_j=1. Confirmed C_2=2/3 and C_3=8/15 from the odd zeta sums. Independently checked rational bounds using 157/50<π<22/7: v_0>0.1886, v_0<0.1901, H_2<0.01632<0.02845<(4/5)v_0². Hence H_m<(4/5)v_0^m for all m≥2. On [v_0,1/5], P_m=(1+H_m)(1-v^m) lies strictly below 1 and its increment is >v^m(1-v)-H_m>0, so P_m^(1/m) strictly increases. This places and orders all unique crossings. From the root equation v_m-v_0=O(5^{-m}/m); therefore v_m^m/v_0^m→1 and H_m=o(v_0^m), giving the sharp coefficient q_0/m. The principal heat-survival coefficient is (4/π)cos(πu/2)>0. At equality u²=1-8/π² put x²=π²/4-2; the Taylor upper bound cos x≤1-x²/2+x⁴/24 and the rational π bounds give a prefactor <0.990. Thus rate and equality comparisons, and the strict variance-versus-tail window, follow. Inspected checker.py only; its finite root and product diagnostics are not proof of the infinite hierarchy.

value.rationale: Equal means remove the trivial scale difference in trapping duration. The strict infinite hierarchy determines which fluctuation orders exceed the clock at each offset and how the transition approaches a spectral threshold. This gives more than a single low-order sign or a few sampled angles and clarifies why larger rare-event survival need not mean larger variance.
